parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols mpls label-switched-path d.explanation: 配置MPLS协议的默认标签交换路径。

set protocols isis level 2 mpls-traffic-.template: set protocols isis level [parameter1] mpls-traffic-engineering router-id [parameter2]

set protocols isis level 2 mpls-traffic-.explanation: 配置ISIS协议的MPLS流量工程的路由器ID。

set protocols isis level 2 mpls-traffic-.template: set protocols isis level [parameter1] mpls-traffic-engineering segment-routing global-block [parameter2] [parameter3]
set protocols isis level 2 mpls-traffic-.command: set protocols isis level 2 mpls-traffic-engineering segment-routing global-block 153616 153800
set protocols isis level 2 mpls-traffic-.explanation: 配置ISIS协议的MPLS流量工程的段路由全局块。

parameters.explanation: 段路由全局块的结束标签。

set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0.0.command: set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0.0 point-to-point
set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0.0.explanation: 配置ISIS协议的接口为点对点类型。

set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0.0.command: set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0.0 point-to-point
set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0.0.explanation: 配置ISIS协议的接口为点对点类型。

set protocols isis interface lo0.0 point.command: set protocols isis interface lo0.0 point-to-point
set protocols isis interface lo0.0 point.explanation: 配置ISIS协议的接口为点对点类型。

set protocols isis interface lo0.0 level.template: set protocols isis interface [parameter1] level [parameter2] metric-style [parameter3]

set protocols isis interface lo0.0 level.template: set protocols isis interface [parameter1] level [parameter2] segment-routing prefix-sid index [parameter3]

set protocols isis interface lo0.0 level.explanation: 配置ISIS协议的接口的段路由前缀SID索引。
